Summary 
 
At Guidewire, quality is a shared responsibility across the software development lifecycle. As an SDET, you will work closely with software engineers, product managers, and other quality engineers to validate end-to-end business workflows across applications and services. You will help ensure that integrated product capabilities work together as expected, identify gaps in cross-functional workflows, and provide confidence in the quality of our products through comprehensive testing.

We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test who is passionate about software quality, test automation, and continuous improvement. You will contribute to test strategy and execution for product features, build and maintain automation, identify risks early, and help improve the effectiveness of our testing practices.

As software engineering evolves with AI, we also expect our SDETs to embrace AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, accelerate test development, and explore new approaches to software quality and validation. 
 Job Description 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Collaborate with PMs, Developers, and other quality engineering teams to understand business requirements, feature changes, and cross-application dependencies. 
 Independently develop test plans and test scenarios for business capabilities, identifying risks, dependencies, and coverage gaps across applications and services. 
 Own end-to-end testing across multiple projects, including test planning, coordination, execution, and tracking through completion. 
 Design scalable, modular test cases for moderately complex workflows. Prioritize coverage based on product risk and automation feasibility, balancing meaningful coverage with long-term maintainability. 
 Build reusable test utilities or framework enhancements that address current project needs and reduce duplication across multiple features or test suites. 
 Develop and maintain automated tests using team frameworks and sound software engineering practices. Review peers' automation and provide actionable feedback on readability and maintainability. 
 Validate functional, integration, regression, end to end and exploratory scenarios across APIs, service integrations, and UI workflows as appropriate. 
 Take ownership of the stability of your automated tests in CI. Improve test execution and troubleshooting by identifying flaky tests, investigating failures, and leveraging AI-powered tools to analyze logs, debug automation, and identify potential root causes. 
 Analyze test results, defect trends, and coverage gaps to identify recurring quality issues, communicate risks, and provide actionable feedback to development teams. 
 Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, scenario generation, automation development, and maintenance, while independently validating AI-generated outputs. 
 Contribute to testing AI-enabled capabilities by validating expected behavior, end-to-end workflow outcomes and report evidence-based findings.. 
 Take ownership of assigned testing areas, mentor junior engineers, and share knowledge and improvements with the broader team. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Strong experience in software testing, quality engineering, and test automation. 
 Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or an equivalent object-oriented language. 
 Hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions using UI automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or TestCafe. 
 Experience with API testing tools and frameworks such as Karate, Postman, or equivalent. 
 Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed applications, and data formats such as JSON and XML. 
 Experience developing test plans and test cases, applying risk-based testing approaches to ensure appropriate coverage. 
 Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, or equivalent. 
 Experience troubleshooting test failures, analyzing results, and identifying underlying issues. 
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across teams. 
 Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and apply new technologies and approaches, including AI-assisted engineering tools. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Playwright and modern JavaScript/TypeScript automation. 
 Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira and Xray. 
 Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS and container technologies such as Docker. 
 Experience with observability and application monitoring tools such as Datadog. 
 Exposure to AI engineering tools or AI-based testing solutions. Experience building AI agents is a plus. 
 Understanding of testing AI-enabled applications, including LLM response evaluation and validation of AI-driven workflows. 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 What Makes You Successful 
 You take ownership of quality rather than viewing testing as simply finding defects. 
 You enjoy solving problems and understanding how systems work. 
 You balance technical depth with practical testing judgment. 
 You write maintainable automation and understand the importance of reliable test coverage. 
 You are comfortable challenging assumptions and communicating risks constructively. 
 You are open to learning, experimenting, and adapting as technology evolves. 
 You value collaboration, integrity, and rationality. 
 
 At Guidewire, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the quality of enterprise and SaaS software products while continuously growing your engineering skills and exploring modern approaches to quality engineering. We value collegiality, integrity, and rationality. We welcome candidates who are curious, pragmatic, and motivated to improve how quality is built into software. 

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 - $210,000. Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. All full-time positions or part-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at Guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. In addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance.


 About Guidewire 

 Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC. 

 Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.
